d: George is so obsessed with Webster winning a derby that he builds the car without him, hurting his feelings since Webster wanted to build the car together.
George secures a $10,000 pledge for Katherine to run in a 10K charity race, but when she's injured, Webster decides to run for her.
The family thinks Papa has a vision problem, but the truth is that Papa never learned to read.
Webster meets a lonely woman on a dare from his friends and finds out that she is not the witch they said she was.
Webster is disillusioned when his TV hero Jed Hammond comes to Chicago and makes a pass at Katherine.

When Mary and Sandra go to court to settle a dispute over song royalties, Sandra's ammunition is veteran 'barrister' John Houseman, while Mary's ace in the hole is a 'Supreme' expert witness, singer Mary Wilson.
Mayhem and murder plague 227 when a mysterious man with a knife rents an apartment in Mary's building.

When Mary and Lester go to the reading of his uncle's will, they are both surprised to learn they have distant cousins whom they've never met, and even more confused when they discover they are a different color.
When Lester's old high school sweetheart comes to the neighborhood in search of a new home, Mary fears that she'll try to move in on more than just her turf.
Suffering from a very cold winter spell, the residents of '227' invade Mary and Lester's apartment, which is one of two apartments with heat.
When Mary and Lester's school teacher friend Mitchell meets Sandra, he sets out to win her pampered heart, no matter how many gifts or expensive dates it takes.
After a whirlwind courtship, Sandra accepts Mitchell's wedding proposal, making a commitment to trade in her glamorous life for what she not-so-long-ago considered a boring existence.
When Tom Willis makes opening his own business more important than his family and friends, he may get the business but lose everything else.
Louise makes it very clear to George that she doesn't want another child in the house, but he makes sure she gets one anyway, and he lives to regret it.

st: George And Louise In A Bind
d: A burglar ties up George and Louise and gives them a night to remember in a special 90-minute episode. As they wait to be rescued, George and Louise re-live (by flashback) some of their most unforgettable and hilarious experiences.
Jenny Jefferson's thesis research on street gangs teaches her and her family a horrifying lesson in life...and death.
George riled by bare facts.
George's unexpected offer to help Louise and Allan cut through the red tape that's delaying the move of the Help Center turns into more trouble than anyone is prepared to handle.

Fred's failure to pay any bills brings threats of turned off utilities and repossessed furniture. But when the collection agents come to take away the furniture, the quick thinking Fred turns a fall into a fast fortune.

Lamont buys two coffins at an auction and is determined to sell them at a large profit. Very superstitious about having coffins in the house, Fred decides to sleep in the back of the truck until they are sold.

Lamont strongly objects to his father's proposal of marriage to the widow Donna Harris (Lynn Hamilton). Lamont's protestations that no one can take the place of his mother leads to a heated three?way argument and one fiery exit.

Fred wants a color television and Lamont wants a car, but they can't afford both. Fred, enraged to learn that Lamont went ahead and bought the car, ends up in the hospital with amnesia, a very sympathetic son and a suspicious twinkle in his eye.
Lamont stumbles upon a suitcase full of what he's sure is stolen money and calls the police to come take it away. Not wanting to take any chances, Fred locks the find up in the safe.
Fred and Donna have reconciled their differences and are once again planning to wed. Fred even gives her an engagement ring to make it official.
A great deal on a grand piano finds Lamont and Fred lodged in the apartment of a wealthy eccentric.

When Fred Sanford receives a slight injury in a car mishap, Lamont finds himself waiting on his father hand and foot. Fred rejects the idea of having Aunt Ethel help him around the house and settles for Lamont's zany plan to hire a housekeeper.
Mark helps a student basketball player (CHRISTOPHER CARTER) pass an important algebra test. Chris Tucker guest stars.
When Mark coaches a girls' cheerleading team, he desperately asks Vanessa to help him train the untalented cheerleaders.
After Mark finally gets a permanent teaching job as a basketball coach, he's offered a contract to play for the Warriors, a professional basketball team. First of a two-part episode.

Mark is given a temporary contract to play professional basketball with his favorite team, the Warriors. Unfortunately, Mark must play guard against basketball star Charles Barkley (HIMSELF). Second of a two-part episode.
Mark and Robin try to make Andre choose between his interests in basketball and music.
